description: Veltadoc turns a spreadsheet into hundreds of branded PDF documents in one batch. Upload a CSV or Excel file, map your columns to a template once, and generate invoices, payslips, certificates, purchase orders, and more, all downloadable as a single ZIP. Saved mappings and custom branding available on Pro. Free plan available, no card required.

name: VibeRewrite
tagline: Rewrite the vibe. Keep the message. 🌶️
description: Rewrite any message into Polite, Corporate, Passive-Aggressive, and more. VibeRewrite rewrites your message in the tone you actually meant. Paste your text, pick a vibe, and get it rewritten - meaning intact. It helps with: - Making your message clear and respectful without sounding robotic - Adding confidence without sounding aggressive - Keeping urgency without triggering defensiveness - Turning "oops" drafts into something you'd be proud to send In short: same message, better delivery. 🌶️

tagline: Healthcare Conversations, Simplified.
description: VisitAssist is an easy-to-use phone-based tool that joins a medical visit, records the conversation, prompts helpful questions, and creates a clear, easy-to-understand summary. The recap can be shared with family members, caregivers, or care managers to support better care coordination and help older adults age in place.

name: Wander - Explore Together
tagline: Find someone to join you, wherever you go.
description: With the Wander app, you'll be able to instantly connect with other people who plan to travel to the same destination(s) as you over the same dates. Whether you’re backpacking solo, going on a short vacation with friends, or simply exploring your own city, anyone can use Wander to find others to join them! Users are able to create their own trips for others to join, or to search for other people’s existing trips and request to join those themselves.

name: Webbu
tagline: Edit your website by typing what you want changed.
description: Most "AI website editors" generate new sites. Webbu edits the one you already have — your actual GitHub repo, your live Shopify store, your real production code. Type the change you want. Webbu opens a PR, updates the storefront, ships it. Built for Shopify operators and small agencies who'd rather make a code change in a sentence than a sprint. $200/mo, no free trial — we run real inference on real code. webbu.ai

name: Webstorio

description: Webstorio is an AI Web Builder Platform with Everything Built-in. Unlike other AI website builders that generate a full codebase, Webstorio helps you manage and grow your website long term. Generate a website from a prompt, customize it visually, manage content with a built-in CMS, and use integrated authentication, payments, SEO, analytics, hosting, and more. All in one platform. Build faster. Maintain with confidence.

name: WinifyAI
tagline: AI RFP response software for fast-moving teams
description: WinifyAI helps teams respond to RFPs faster by reusing the best content from past proposals, questionnaires, and knowledge sources. Generate stronger first drafts, reduce repetitive work, and keep response quality high across bids.

name: WonderPlay
tagline: Where kids learn, create and play with AI wonderplay
description: WonderPlay is an AI-powered learning app making education fun for kids 1–10. It offers interactive bedtime stories, sing-along songs, learning games, word puzzles, alphabet, numbers, colors, math exercises, and creative activities. Parents set safe profiles and age-appropriate content. Works on mobile, tablet, and desktop. WonderPlay is a magical world where children learn letters, numbers, life skills, and creativity while having fun.

name: Wordy
tagline: Learn languages from real movie clips with quizzes
description: Wordy started as a personal tool because I kept pausing movies to look up words and forgetting them minutes later. Now it's a full language learning app built around real movie clips. Pick a language, watch short native scenes, quiz yourself on the vocabulary, and review with spaced repetition flashcards. No cartoon exercises, just real content from movies and TV you'd actually want to watch. 20+ languages. iOS, Android, and Chrome extension.

No more digging for data. No more clicking through CRM screens. Just ask, decide, and act in seconds.
